  SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions s JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=s.location_id
  JOIN public.master_v2_participants mp ON mp.session_id=s.id AND mp.user_id_snapshot=p_user
   AND mp.left_at IS NULL AND mp.engagement_state='attivo'
  JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=mp.character_id AND ch.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
  JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id=p_user AND pr.role IN('admin','master')
  WHERE s.id=p_session AND s.owner_kind='ai_service' AND s.master_user IS NULL
   AND s.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND l.is_active AND l.is_test AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.suspended_at IS NULL
   AND s.stato='in_corso')
  OR mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(p_session) IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 WITH released AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.id AS work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
    'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision) AS request,
   sw.context->>'source_revision' AS source_revision,
   jsonb_build_object('source_window_id',sw.id,'source_revision',sw.context->>'source_revision',
    'reason',sw.superseded_reason,'audit_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(a.details)) AS release
  FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id
   AND sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr ON dr.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id
   AND dr.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=w.id
   AND dr.request_key=w.request_key AND dr.status='failed' AND dr.dispatch_count=0
   AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND dr.charged_cost_usd=0 AND dr.upper_bound_cost_usd=0
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a ON a.receipt_id=dr.id
   AND a.event_code='staff_preprovider_request_retry'
   AND ((w.id='d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e'::uuid AND a.details->>'schema_version'='c1266-request-size-release/1') OR (w.id='f4f7185e-4aae-4edd-ac24-65f8dcfa36f5'::uuid AND a.details->>'schema_version'='c1266-turn-recovery-release/1'))
   AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND a.details->>'source_window_id'=sw.id::text
  WHERE p_session='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid
   AND w.master_session_id=p_session AND w.id IN('d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e'::uuid,'f4f7185e-4aae-4edd-ac24-65f8dcfa36f5'::uuid)
   AND w.state='failed' AND w.kind='director' AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND w.message_id IS NULL
   AND w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result)
   AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
   AND sw.context->>'source_revision'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
   AND sw.superseded_reason='staff_preprovider_request_retry'
   AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(sw.id)
 ),
 candidates AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.*,jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
   'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision) AS request
  FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w
  WHERE w.master_session_id=p_session AND w.state='completed' AND w.kind IN('director','narration')
   AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
   AND w.result_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
  ORDER BY w.created_at DESC,w.id LIMIT 128
 ), qualified AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.* FROM candidates w
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr ON dr.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id
   AND dr.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=w.id
   AND dr.request_key=w.request_key AND dr.status='success' AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND dr.event_kind='mission_generic_event' AND dr.renderer_version='mission-generic-runtime/1'
   AND dr.request_fingerprint=mission_internal.fingerprint(w.request)
   AND dr.envelope_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(dr.envelope) AND dr.authority_sha256=dr.envelope_sha256
   AND dr.envelope->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND dr.envelope->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
   AND dr.envelope->>'event_id'=w.event_id::text AND dr.envelope->>'authority_receipt_id'=w.authority_receipt_id::text
   AND dr.envelope->>'payload_sha256'=w.payload_sha256 AND dr.envelope->>'definition_sha256'=w.definition_sha256
   AND dr.envelope->'revision'=to_jsonb(w.revision)
  WHERE mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(w.id)->>'execution_context'='staff_mission'
   AND 1=(SELECT count(*) FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
    WHERE a.receipt_id=dr.id AND a.event_code='c1266_async_owner_v1'
     AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(a.details,ARRAY['schema_version','actor_user_id','work_id','request_sha256','envelope_sha256','provider_timeout_ms'])
     AND a.details->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-async-owner/1'
     AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND a.details->>'request_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.request)
     AND a.details->>'envelope_sha256'=dr.envelope_sha256 AND a.details->'provider_timeout_ms'='240000'::jsonb)
 ), published AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.id AS writer_work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,w.message_id
  FROM qualified w JOIN public.messages msg ON msg.id=w.message_id
   AND msg.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND msg.kind='fato' AND msg.recipient_user IS NULL AND msg.body=w.result->>'text'
  WHERE w.kind='narration' AND (
   EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.id=ub.source_window_id
     AND sw.master_session_id=p_session AND sw.consumed_message_id=w.message_id
    WHERE ub.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND ub.master_session_id=p_session AND ub.writer_work_id=w.id
     AND ub.state='published' AND ub.published_at IS NOT NULL AND ub.message_id=w.message_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs
    JOIN public.mission_run_publications pub ON pub.master_session_id=bs.master_session_id AND pub.event_id=bs.event_id
    JOIN public.mission_run_outbox ob ON ob.publication_id=pub.id AND ob.master_session_id=p_session AND ob.event_id=bs.event_id
     AND ob.state='published' AND ob.published_at IS NOT NULL
    WHERE bs.master_session_id=p_session AND bs.id=w.event_id AND bs.id=w.authority_receipt_id
     AND bs.id::text=w.payload->>'opening_start_receipt_id' AND bs.state='published' AND bs.published_at IS NOT NULL
     AND bs.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text AND bs.result->>'event_id'=bs.event_id::text
     AND bs.result->>'start_receipt_id'=bs.id::text
     AND pub.context_fingerprint=bs.result->>'context_fingerprint' AND ob.context_fingerprint=pub.context_fingerprint
     AND pub.status='committed'
     AND pub.body_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(msg.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')))
 ), settled_raw AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.request,w.id AS work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256) AS publication
  FROM qualified w JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=w.id WHERE w.kind='narration'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.request,w.id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256)
  FROM qualified w
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id
   AND sw.master_session_id=p_session AND sw.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL AND sw.superseded_at IS NULL
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub ON ub.source_window_id=sw.id AND ub.decision_work_id=w.id
   AND ub.master_session_id=p_session AND ub.state='published' AND ub.published_at IS NOT NULL
   AND ub.message_id=sw.consumed_message_id
  JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=ub.writer_work_id AND p.message_id=sw.consumed_message_id
  WHERE w.kind='director'
 ), settled AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM settled_raw s WHERE 1=(SELECT count(DISTINCT check_s.publication)
   FROM settled_raw check_s WHERE check_s.work_id=s.work_id AND check_s.request=s.request)
 ), items AS(
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',s.request),
   'request',s.request,'work_id',s.work_id,'receipt_id',s.receipt_id,'result_sha256',s.result_sha256,'publication',s.publication) AS item
  FROM settled s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','staff_tick','source_revision',t.source_revision),
   'request',s.request,'work_id',s.work_id,'receipt_id',s.receipt_id,'result_sha256',s.result_sha256,'publication',s.publication)
  FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr
   ON pr.master_session_id=p_session AND pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
   AND pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pr.result)
   AND (
    (pr.request_key=t.request_key AND pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256)
    OR EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM released rel
     JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts original_pr ON original_pr.request_key=t.request_key
      AND original_pr.master_session_id=p_session AND original_pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
      AND original_pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256
      AND original_pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(original_pr.result)
      AND original_pr.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1'
      AND original_pr.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
      AND original_pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request
     WHERE rel.source_revision=t.source_revision
      AND pr.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(rel.work_id,
       'mission-staff-released-director-retry/1:'||t.source_revision)))
   AND pr.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND pr.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
  JOIN settled s ON s.request=pr.result->'dispatch'
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.work_id=s.work_id AND sw.master_session_id=p_session
   AND sw.context->>'source_revision'=t.source_revision AND sw.consumed_message_id=(s.publication->>'message_id')::uuid
  WHERE t.master_session_id=p_session AND t.source_revision ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=t.staff_user_id AND p.role IN('admin','master'))

  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',rel.request),
   'request',rel.request,'work_id',rel.work_id,'receipt_id',rel.receipt_id,'result_sha256',rel.result_sha256,'release',rel.release)
  FROM released rel
  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','staff_tick','source_revision',t.source_revision),
   'request',rel.request,'work_id',rel.work_id,'receipt_id',rel.receipt_id,'result_sha256',rel.result_sha256,'release',rel.release)
  FROM released rel
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t ON t.master_session_id=p_session AND t.source_revision=rel.source_revision
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr ON pr.request_key=t.request_key
   AND pr.master_session_id=p_session AND pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
   AND pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256 AND pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pr.result)
   AND pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request
 ), bounded AS(SELECT DISTINCT item FROM items ORDER BY item LIMIT 128)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema_version',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM released) THEN 'mission-journal-settlements/2' ELSE 'mission-journal-settlements/1' END,'master_session_id',p_session,
  'items',coalesce(jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item),'[]'::jsonb)) INTO result FROM bounded;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_generic_room_state_v1(p_location uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare uid uuid:=auth.uid();m public.master_v2_sessions;r public.mission_run_state;vchoices jsonb;
 staff boolean;participant boolean;objective text;active boolean; uf_work mission_generic_owner.work_items;uf_processing jsonb;uf_rounds jsonb;uf_progress_key text;uf_state text;uf_marker jsonb;uf_review boolean;
 academy boolean;flow_state text;flow_publication uuid;role_diag jsonb;
 private_source_step text;private_pending boolean:=false;
 staff_tick_view jsonb:=NULL;st_revision text;st_tick mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1;st_receipt mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts;
 st_work record;st_source record;st_dispatch jsonb;st_next_key uuid;st_original_key uuid;st_owner boolean:=false;
 st_valid boolean:=false;st_released boolean:=false;st_blocked boolean:=false;st_resume boolean:=false;
 st_ack_predecessor uuid:=NULL;st_candidate_predecessor uuid:=NULL;
 st_depth integer:=0;st_state text;st_public_state text;st_recovery uuid;st_effective_id uuid;
 st_budget_a mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions;st_budget_g mission_generic_owner.provider_policy;st_budget_p record;
 st_spent numeric;st_http bigint;st_bound numeric;st_cap_cost numeric;st_cap_http integer;st_budget_ok boolean:=false;
 opening_resume49 jsonb:=NULL;opening_claim_resume6 jsonb:=NULL;
 journal_settlements jsonb:=NULL;
 c26_count_view jsonb:=NULL;c26_driver jsonb:=NULL;c26_proof jsonb;c26_kind text;c26_revision text;c26_phase_kind text;
begin
 if uid is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode='28000';end if;
 staff:=exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=uid and role in('admin','master'));
 select s.* into m from public.master_v2_sessions s join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings b on b.master_session_id=s.id
 where s.location_id=p_location and s.closed_at is null and s.owner_kind='ai_service'
 and (staff or exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
  where p.session_id=s.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null)) order by s.created_at desc limit 1;
 if m.id is null then return null;end if;
 perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(m.id);
 select * into strict r from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=m.id;
 select sw.step_key into private_source_step from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches pending_batch
 join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw on sw.id=pending_batch.source_window_id
 where pending_batch.master_session_id=m.id AND pending_batch.composition_kind='entry_png'
   AND pending_batch.state IN('preparing','ready') AND pending_batch.message_id IS NULL
   AND pending_batch.encounter_id IS NOT NULL
 order by pending_batch.created_at desc,pending_batch.id desc limit 1;
 private_pending:=private_source_step IS NOT NULL;
 participant:=exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
 where p.session_id=m.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null);
 -- Quest uses its own native source (mission_id is NULL). No private context is emitted.
 academy:=mission_creation_owner.director_context(m.id,r.current_step_key) is not null
 or exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources qs
   join public.mission_plan_versions pv on pv.id=qs.plan_version_id
   join public.mission_plans qp on qp.id=pv.plan_id
   join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings qb on qb.master_session_id=qs.session_id
   join mission_generic_owner.definitions qd on qd.id=qb.definition_id
   join public.locations ql on ql.id=qs.location_id
   where qs.session_id=m.id and qs.state in('prepared','opening_pending','uncertain','started')
    and m.mission_id is null and m.tipo='quest' and qs.location_id=m.location_id
    and qs.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id and qp.source_kind='quest'
    and qp.quest_episode_id=qs.episode_id and qp.quest_source_sha256=qs.source_sha256
    and qd.id=qs.definition_id and qd.plan_version_id=qs.plan_version_id
    and qd.plan_sha256=r.plan_sha256 and qb.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qb.snapshot)
    and qd.definition_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qd.definition)
    and ql.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid and ql.is_active and ql.is_test);
 select public_objective into objective from public.mission_plan_steps where plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id
   and step_key=coalesce(private_source_step,r.current_step_key);
 if participant and not academy then vchoices:=public.mission_generic_choices_v1(m.id);
 else vchoices:=jsonb_build_object('choices','[]'::jsonb);end if;
 active:=m.stato in('preparazione','in_corso') and m.suspended_at is null and r.run_phase in('preparazione','in_corso');
 -- Public metadata only; no work payload, private intent, role or provider configuration.
 select uf_candidate.* into uf_work from mission_generic_owner.work_items uf_candidate
where uf_candidate.master_session_id=m.id
 and not exists(
   select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows superseded_role
   left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches superseded_batch
     on superseded_batch.source_window_id=superseded_role.id
   where superseded_role.master_session_id=m.id
     and mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(superseded_role.id)
     and (superseded_role.work_id=uf_candidate.id
       or superseded_batch.writer_work_id=uf_candidate.id))
 and not (m.id='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(m.id)
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows superseded
     where superseded.id=uf_candidate.id and superseded.superseded_at is not null))
 and not (
  m.id='93d78313-abde-4087-9eb7-7b96bc0fa089'::uuid
  and m.location_id='6c737082-8fc7-4fd8-b246-30297a1ed1af'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.id='3076c471-37c5-438e-8f50-0a790b787e05'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.kind='choice' and uf_candidate.state='failed'
  and uf_candidate.encounter_id='deadfef6-5b16-4921-aa86-b86ffad6f2f2'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.step_key=r.current_step_key
  and uf_candidate.run_control_version=r.control_version
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'actor_id'='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'round_id'='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'
  and uf_candidate.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.payload)
  and uf_candidate.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.result)
  and uf_candidate.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'charged_cost_usd'='0'
  and (select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid='mission_generic_owner.enqueue_choice(uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
      ='76a88f0e93752e1456c90d160a7a855d'
  and exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
    where ub.id='fbfc8e29-8724-4241-b2fe-22dbc17eb9e7'::uuid
      and ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.encounter_id=uf_candidate.encounter_id
      and ub.state='preparing' and ub.entry_side='png'
      and ub.next_round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items rw
    where rw.master_session_id=m.id
      and rw.dedupe_key=uf_candidate.dedupe_key||':recovery:'||uf_candidate.id::text
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from public.combat_v2_declarations d
    where d.round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
      and d.actor_id='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'::uuid
  )
 )
 order by (uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed')) desc,
  case when uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed') then uf_candidate.created_at end asc,
  uf_candidate.created_at desc,uf_candidate.id limit 1;
 if uf_work.id is not null then
  uf_state:=case when uf_work.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
    and uf_work.lease_expires_at<=statement_timestamp() then 'uncertain' else uf_work.state end;
  uf_processing:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-processing/1',
   'work_id',uf_work.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
   'revision',uf_work.revision,'state',uf_state,'created_at',uf_work.created_at,
   'finalized_at',uf_work.finalized_at,'message_id',uf_work.message_id,
   'request',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1',
    'master_session_id',m.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
    'expected_revision',uf_work.revision));
 end if;
 -- Freeze only identities/states needed to wake progress, never the clock. Include
 -- declarations because a completed defense may advance mechanics without a run transition.
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('encounter_id',uf_enc.id,'state',uf_enc.state,
  'rounds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('round_id',uf_r.id,'phase',uf_r.phase,
    'state',uf_r.state,'report_id',uf_r.report_id,'narrated_at',uf_r.narrated_at,
    'declarations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(uf_d.id,uf_d.state) order by uf_d.id)
       from public.combat_v2_declarations uf_d where uf_d.round_id=uf_r.id),'[]'::jsonb)) order by uf_r.round_no)
   from (select uf_round.* from public.combat_v2_rounds uf_round where uf_round.session_id=uf_enc.id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.unified_director_commit(p_work uuid, p_decision jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare ww mission_generic_owner.work_items;uw mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows;ub mission_generic_owner.unified_batches;
 opportunity jsonb;spec jsonb;sc jsonb;nk text[];mm public.master_v2_sessions;mr public.mission_run_state;result jsonb;eid uuid;role_ref uuid;role_actor uuid;role_sha text;transition_kind text;is_v2 boolean;intent_keys text[];expected_schema text;c1266_bundle jsonb;
begin

 if not mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled((select master_session_id from mission_generic_owner.work_items where id=p_work)) then return mission_generic_owner.flow_previous_unified_director_commit(p_work,p_decision);end if; 
perform mission_ai_board_owner.service_only();
perform 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
  where c.master_session_id=(select master_session_id from mission_generic_owner.work_items where id=p_work)
  for update;
if not found then raise exception 'MRS_V4_DIRECTOR_CURSOR_REQUIRED';end if;
perform public.master_v2_lock_scope((select master_session_id from mission_generic_owner.work_items where id=p_work));
select * into strict ww from mission_generic_owner.work_items where id=p_work for update;

 perform mission_generic_owner.work_assert(ww);
 IF mission_generic_owner.c1266_opening_named_v1(ww.master_session_id) AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_execution_authority_v1(ww.master_session_id,false,true) IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_DIRECTOR5_COMMIT_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 if ww.kind<>'director' or (ww.state<>'provider_started' AND NOT ((ww.id='e366b9fa-54dc-4abd-8ba6-9ceee83be9a4'::uuid AND ww.master_session_id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid
 AND ww.kind='director' AND ww.state='failed' AND ww.receipt_id='07366817-3bf6-4bad-8387-0a4c0d1804f7'::uuid
 AND ww.dispatch_receipt_id='e9524086-1e03-42d8-866b-1c12eb77840a'::uuid
 AND ww.payload_sha256='52ae7392cc038543f01c3a9d07532a292c6f9b7cf044d52b2ce2d0a9a7b77754'
 AND ww.result_sha256='d0a4266f89198307e8c9020af67b4d2b099edc1cbf20e0aea5b38d1b78fc8ea9'
 AND public.combat_v2_sha256(ww.result)='674c8253e511750022b6d9b477383aed5743ffb2c9ceee7b35a0125c10ac6201'
 AND ww.result->>'ok'='true' AND ww.result->>'provider_calls'='1' AND ww.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 wc WHERE wc.work_id=ww.id AND wc.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id
  AND wc.contract_sha256='0c4e3f0016df29ed7b740336e90ba58d6b1e8d72ac21ed144b9796d32073ecce'
  AND wc.contract_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(wc.contract) AND wc.release_sha256='e58e2e460469dced1c6efb98858b23f043fe8976988ae15bcb25525becc70cd8')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit ga ON ga.receipt_id=dr.id AND ga.event_code='generic_finalized'
  JOIN staff_ai_quota_private.calls q ON q.source_id=dr.id AND q.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND q.call_no=1 AND q.scope_id=ww.master_session_id AND q.state='settled' AND q.charged_usd=dr.charged_cost_usd
  WHERE dr.id=ww.dispatch_receipt_id AND dr.status='success' AND dr.dispatch_count=1 AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND dr.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=ww.id AND dr.request_key=ww.request_key
   AND ga.details->>'work_id'=ww.id::text AND ga.details->>'receipt_id'=ww.receipt_id::text
   AND ga.details->>'application_error_sqlstate'='54000' AND ga.details->'command_receipt'='null'::jsonb
   AND ga.details->>'stale'='false' AND ga.details->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'
   AND ga.details->>'result_sha256'=ww.result_sha256 AND ga.details->>'result_jsonb_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(ww.result))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness rr WHERE rr.singleton AND rr.state='enabled'
  AND rr.revision_sha256=rr.observed_revision_sha256 AND rr.revision_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(rr.canonical_preimage,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  AND rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_raw_input_recovery,schema_version}'='c1266-raw-input-recovery/1'
  AND rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_raw_input_recovery,failed_work_id}'=ww.id::text
  AND rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_raw_input_recovery,result_sha256}'=ww.result_sha256
  AND rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_raw_input_recovery,commit_source_md5}'=(SELECT md5(p.prosrc)FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid='mission_generic_owner.unified_director_commit(uuid,jsonb)'::regprocedure)
  AND rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_raw_input_recovery,cached_source_md5}'=(SELECT md5(p.prosrc)FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid='public.mission_generic_staff_republish_failed_v1(uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure))) AND p_decision IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ww.result->'decision')) then raise exception 'MUF_DIRECTOR_WORK';end if;
 select * into strict uw from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows where id=ww.authority_receipt_id and work_id=ww.id for update;
 if uw.master_session_id<>ww.master_session_id or uw.step_key<>ww.step_key or uw.run_control_version<>ww.run_control_version
 or uw.definition_sha256<>ww.definition_sha256 or uw.source_sha256<>ww.payload_sha256 or uw.context is distinct from ww.payload->'context'
 or uw.opportunities is distinct from ww.payload->'opportunities' then raise exception 'MUF_WINDOW_BINDING';end if;
 if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(uw.context->'sources') source_role where source_role->>'kind'='role' and not exists(
  select 1 from public.messages sm where sm.id=(source_role->>'id')::uuid and sm.body=source_role->>'body' and sm.recipient_user is null
  and encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(sm.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')=source_role->>'sha256')) then raise exception 'MUF_DIRECTOR_ROLE_DRIFT';end if;
 IF ww.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-director-work/4' THEN
  IF NOT mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v2(ww.master_session_id,true) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_TEMPORAL_COMMIT_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
  c1266_bundle:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_decision_v2(ww.id,p_decision);
  p_decision:=c1266_bundle->'original_core_decision';
 END IF;
 IF ww.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-director-work/3' THEN
  c1266_bundle:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_decision_v1(ww.id,p_decision);
  p_decision:=c1266_bundle->'original_core_decision';
 END IF;
 select * into ub from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches where decision_work_id=ww.id;
 if found then
  if ub.decision is distinct from coalesce(c1266_bundle->'stored_decision',p_decision) then raise exception 'MUF_DECISION_REPLAY';end if;return jsonb_build_object('batch_id',ub.id,'state',ub.state);
 end if;
 is_v2:=ww.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-director-work/2' OR c1266_bundle IS NOT NULL;
 expected_schema:='mission-director-proposal/1';
 if is_v2 then expected_schema:='mission-director-proposal/2';end if;
 if not mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(p_decision,array['schema_version','source_window_id','source_role_ids','source_evidence','opportunity_id','action_kind','entry_side','world_reaction_intent','npc_intents'])
 or p_decision->>'schema_version' is distinct from expected_schema or p_decision->>'source_window_id' is distinct from uw.id::text
 or jsonb_typeof(p_decision->'source_role_ids') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_decision->'source_role_ids')=0
 or jsonb_typeof(p_decision->'source_evidence') is distinct from 'array'
 or jsonb_array_length(p_decision->'source_evidence')>8
 or jsonb_array_length(p_decision->'source_evidence')=0
 or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'source_evidence') ev
  where not mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(ev,array['role_id','quote'])
   or ev->>'role_id' is null or not ((ev->>'role_id')::uuid=any(uw.role_ids))
   or not (p_decision->'source_role_ids' ? (ev->>'role_id'))
   or nullif(btrim(ev->>'quote'),'') is null or length(ev->>'quote')>300
   or not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(uw.context->'sources') ss
    where ss->>'kind'='role' and ss->>'id'=ev->>'role_id'
     and position(ev->>'quote' in ss->>'body')>0))
 or (exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows prior_window
   join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches prior_batch on prior_batch.source_window_id=prior_window.id
   where prior_window.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id and prior_window.step_key=ww.step_key
    and prior_window.run_control_version=ww.run_control_version
    and prior_batch.composition_kind='narrative_continuation' and prior_batch.state='published')
  and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'source_evidence') ev
   join public.messages fresh_role on fresh_role.id=(ev->>'role_id')::uuid
   where (exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors current_cursor
      join mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(ww.master_session_id) latest
        on latest.message_id=fresh_role.id and latest.valid
      where current_cursor.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id)
    or (not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors current_cursor
      where current_cursor.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id)
      and fresh_role.created_at>(select max(prior_fato.created_at)
       from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows prior_window
       join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches prior_batch on prior_batch.source_window_id=prior_window.id
       join public.messages prior_fato on prior_fato.id=prior_batch.message_id
       where prior_window.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id and prior_window.step_key=ww.step_key
        and prior_window.run_control_version=ww.run_control_version
        and prior_batch.composition_kind='narrative_continuation' and prior_batch.state='published')))))

 or jsonb_typeof(p_decision->'npc_intents') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_typeof(p_decision->'world_reaction_intent') is distinct from 'string'
 or length(p_decision->>'world_reaction_intent')>2500

 then raise exception 'MUF_DIRECTOR_PROPOSAL_INVALID';end if;

  end if;

 end if;

  select coalesce(array_agg(ni->>'actor_key'),'{}') into intent_keys from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni;

        'actor_key',actor->>'actor_key','visible_on_enter',true,
        'visibility_trigger_key',null,
        'entry_capabilities',coalesce(actor#>'{entry_policy,entry_capabilities}',
          '["speak","gesture","utility"]'::jsonb)-'offense',
        'offense_allowed',false)),'[]'::jsonb),
      'destination_context',uw.context,'trigger_key',null,'encounter_key',null)
    into opportunity
    from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') actor
    where mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_actor_visible(
      ww.master_session_id,ww.step_key,actor->>'actor_key',null)
      and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(uw.context->'actors') ca
        where ca->>'id'='png:'||(actor->>'actor_key'));
  end if;
  if cardinality(intent_keys)<>(select count(distinct actor_key) from unnest(intent_keys) actor_key)
    or (opportunity is null and cardinality(intent_keys)>0)
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni
      where not mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(ni,array['actor_key','intent','entry_kind','speech_intent'])
        or jsonb_typeof(ni->'intent')<>'string' or length(ni->>'intent')>1500
        or ni->>'entry_kind' not in('speak','gesture','utility','offense')
        or jsonb_typeof(ni->'speech_intent') not in('null','string')
        or length(coalesce(ni->>'speech_intent',''))>700
        or (ni->>'speech_intent' is not null and ni->>'entry_kind' not in('speak','offense'))
        or (ni->>'speech_intent' is not null and ni->>'entry_kind'='speak'
          and not exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_sessions staff_session
            where staff_session.id=ww.master_session_id
              and staff_session.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid))
        or not (
          exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(opportunity->'destination_entry_candidates','[]'::jsonb)) candidate
            where candidate->>'actor_key'=ni->>'actor_key'
              and (candidate->>'visible_on_enter'='true' or
                (candidate->>'visibility_trigger_key' is not null and candidate->>'visibility_trigger_key'=opportunity->>'trigger_key')
                or (opportunity->>'trigger_key' is null
                  and mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_actor_visible(ww.master_session_id,ww.step_key,
                    candidate->>'actor_key',null)))
              and candidate->'entry_capabilities' ? (ni->>'entry_kind')
              and (ni->>'speech_intent' is null or candidate->'entry_capabilities' ? 'speak')
              and ((ni->>'entry_kind'<>'speak' and ni->>'speech_intent' is null)
                or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(opportunity#>'{destination_context,actors}',uw.context->'actors','[]'::jsonb)) context_actor
                  where context_actor->>'id'='png:'||(ni->>'actor_key') and context_actor->>'may_speak'='true'))
              and (ni->>'entry_kind'<>'offense' or candidate->>'offense_allowed'='true'))
          or (opportunity->'allowed_actor_keys' ? (ni->>'actor_key')
            and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') legacy_actor
              where legacy_actor->>'actor_key'=ni->>'actor_key'
                and not (legacy_actor ? 'entry_policy'))
            and (ni->>'entry_kind'<>'speak' or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(opportunity#>'{destination_context,actors}',uw.context->'actors','[]'::jsonb)) context_actor
              where context_actor->>'id'='png:'||(ni->>'actor_key') and context_actor->>'may_speak'='true'))
            and (ni->>'speech_intent' is null or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(opportunity#>'{destination_context,actors}',uw.context->'actors','[]'::jsonb)) context_actor
              where context_actor->>'id'='png:'||(ni->>'actor_key') and context_actor->>'may_speak'='true'))))
        )
  then raise exception 'MNE_DIRECTOR_ENTRY_INVALID' using errcode='22023';end if;
  if cardinality(nk)>0 and (opportunity->>'encounter_key' is null or p_decision->>'entry_side'<>'png')
  then raise exception 'MNE_OFFENSE_ENCOUNTER_REQUIRED' using errcode='42501';end if;
  if p_decision->>'entry_side'='png' and cardinality(nk)=0
  then raise exception 'MNE_OFFENSE_INITIATOR_REQUIRED' using errcode='22023';end if;
  if p_decision->>'entry_side' is null and cardinality(nk)=0 and opportunity is not null then
   opportunity:=jsonb_set(opportunity,'{encounter_key}','null'::jsonb);
  end if;
 else
  select coalesce(array_agg(ni->>'actor_key'),'{}') into nk from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni;
  if cardinality(nk)<>(select count(distinct ak) from unnest(nk) ak)
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni
      where not mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(ni,array['actor_key','intent'])
        or jsonb_typeof(ni->'intent') is distinct from 'string' or length(ni->>'intent')>1500
        or not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') aa where aa->>'actor_key'=ni->>'actor_key'))
  then raise exception 'MUF_DIRECTOR_ACTORS';end if;
  if opportunity is not null and exists(select 1 from unnest(nk) offered_actor where not(opportunity->'allowed_actor_keys' ? offered_actor))
  then raise exception 'MUF_INTENT_NOT_OFFERED';end if;
 end if;
 if opportunity->>'encounter_key' is not null then
  if opportunity->>'trigger_key' is not null then
    if (p_decision->>'entry_side'<>'ambiguous'
      and not (opportunity->'allowed_entry_sides' ? (p_decision->>'entry_side')))
      or (sc ? 'arrival_conflict' and (sc#>>'{arrival_conflict,encounter_key}' is distinct from opportunity->>'encounter_key'
        or (p_decision->>'entry_side'<>'ambiguous' and sc#>>'{arrival_conflict,entry_side}' is distinct from p_decision->>'entry_side')))
      or (not(sc ? 'arrival_conflict') and not mission_generic_owner.mandatory_arrival(
        (select plan_version_id from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=ww.master_session_id),sc)
       and not (is_v2 and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(opportunity->'destination_entry_candidates') candidate
         where candidate->>'offense_allowed'='true' and candidate->>'visible_on_enter'='true')))
    then raise exception 'MFC_ARRIVAL_CONFLICT_NOT_CERTIFIED' using errcode='42501';end if;
  elsif not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items intro
    join public.messages fato on fato.id=intro.message_id and fato.kind='fato' and fato.recipient_user is null
    where intro.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id and intro.kind='narration' and intro.state='completed'
      and intro.step_key=ww.step_key and intro.run_control_version=ww.run_control_version
      and exists(select 1 from public.messages role_msg
        where role_msg.id=any(uw.role_ids) and role_msg.created_at>fato.created_at
          and role_msg.id::text=any(select jsonb_array_elements_text(p_decision->'source_role_ids'))))
  then raise exception 'MFC_CONTACT_OR_NEW_ROLE_REQUIRED' using errcode='42501';end if;
  select es into strict spec from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'encounters') es where es->>'encounter_key'=opportunity->>'encounter_key';
  if p_decision->>'entry_side' not in('pg','png','ambiguous') or p_decision->>'entry_side' is null then raise exception 'MUF_ENTRY_SIDE';end if;
  if p_decision->>'entry_side'='png' and (cardinality(nk)=0
   or (not is_v2 and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(spec->'actors') aa
    where aa->>'team'<>spec->>'pg_team' and not ((aa->>'actor_key')=any(nk))
     and not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
      where ar.mission_id=(select mission_id from public.master_v2_sessions where id=ww.master_session_id)
       and ar.actor_key=aa->>'actor_key' and ar.active
       and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p where p.session_id=ww.master_session_id
        and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)))
   or exists(select 1 from unnest(nk) ak where not exists(
    select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(spec->'actors') aa where aa->>'actor_key'=ak and aa->>'team'<>spec->>'pg_team')))
  then raise exception 'MUF_PNG_INITIATIVE_COHORT';end if;
 elsif p_decision->>'entry_side' is not null then raise exception 'MUF_ENTRY_WITHOUT_ENCOUNTER';end if;
 -- All original source/actor/entry-policy checks above ran on the ORIGINAL proposal.
 -- Only after those checks may a well-formed incompatible effect become context.
 IF c1266_bundle IS NOT NULL THEN
  p_decision:=c1266_bundle->'effective_core_decision';
  IF c1266_bundle#>>'{role_disposition,status}'='context_fallback' THEN
   opportunity:=NULL;spec:=NULL;nk:='{}'::text[];intent_keys:='{}'::text[];
   sc:=mission_generic_owner.scene(ww.master_session_id,ww.step_key);
  END IF;
 END IF;
 insert into mission_generic_owner.unified_batches(master_session_id,step_key,run_control_version,entry_side,pg_team,selected_actor_keys,state,
 source_window_id,decision_work_id,decision,decision_sha256,composition_kind,encounter_key,context)
 values(ww.master_session_id,ww.step_key,ww.run_control_version,case when p_decision->>'entry_side'='ambiguous' then null else p_decision->>'entry_side' end,
 spec->>'pg_team',nk,case when p_decision->>'entry_side'='ambiguous' then 'needs_review' else 'preparing' end,uw.id,ww.id,p_decision,
 public.combat_v2_sha256(p_decision),case when opportunity->>'encounter_key' is null then 'narrative_continuation' else 'entry_'||(p_decision->>'entry_side') end,
 opportunity->>'encounter_key',uw.context) returning * into ub;

 IF c1266_bundle IS NOT NULL THEN
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_batches SET decision=c1266_bundle->'stored_decision',
   decision_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(c1266_bundle->'stored_decision') WHERE id=ub.id RETURNING * INTO ub;
 END IF;
 if ub.state='needs_review' then return jsonb_build_object('batch_id',ub.id,'state','needs_review');end if;

 if not is_v2 then raise exception 'MRS_V4_DIRECTOR_PROPOSAL_V2_REQUIRED';end if;
 if coalesce(uw.context->>'source_revision','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   or uw.context->>'source_revision' is distinct from mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(ww.master_session_id)
 then raise exception 'MRS_V4_DIRECTOR_STALE_ROLE' using errcode='40001';end if;
 if opportunity->>'trigger_key' is not null
   and jsonb_typeof(opportunity->'destination_context') is distinct from 'object'
 then raise exception 'MRS_V4_DESTINATION_CONTEXT_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000';end if;
 if is_v2 and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni
   where ni->>'entry_kind'='offense' and ni->>'actor_key' !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$')
 then raise exception 'MRS_V4_DIRECTOR_SLOT_KEY';end if;
 if opportunity->>'quest_terminal_decision_key' is not null then return mission_factory_owner.quest_terminal_director_v1(ub.id,opportunity->>'quest_terminal_decision_key');end if;
 update mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b set
   selected_actor_keys=coalesce((select array_agg(ni->>'actor_key' order by ni->>'actor_key')
     from jsonb_array_elements(p_decision->'npc_intents') ni where ni->>'entry_kind'='offense'),'{}'::text[]),
   context=mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_visible_context(
     jsonb_set(
       jsonb_set(coalesce(opportunity->'destination_context',uw.context),
         '{source_revision}',to_jsonb(uw.context->>'source_revision'),true),
       '{resolved_facts}',
       coalesce(coalesce(opportunity->'destination_context',uw.context)->'resolved_facts','{}'::jsonb)
         || case when opportunity->>'encounter_key' is not null
              and opportunity->>'trigger_key' is not null
              and coalesce(opportunity#>>'{destination_context,step_key}',ww.step_key)<>ww.step_key
            then jsonb_build_object('arrival_conflict',jsonb_build_object(
              'encounter_key',opportunity->>'encounter_key',
              'entry_side',p_decision->>'entry_side',
              'public_cause',opportunity->>'label'))
            else '{}'::jsonb end,true),
     mission_generic_owner.scene(ww.master_session_id,
       coalesce(opportunity#>>'{destination_context,step_key}',ww.step_key)),ub.id)
 where b.id=ub.id;
 perform mission_generic_owner.unified_enqueue_writer(ub.id);
 return jsonb_build_object('batch_id',ub.id,'state','writer_ready');
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.staff_journal_settlements_v1(p_session uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- This private reader is called only from the already authenticated room projection.
 -- Settled collective publications are readable by each current Staff participant;
 -- they confer no owner, retry, claim, tick, provider or gameplay authority.
 IF p_session IS NULL OR p_user IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions s JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=s.location_id
  JOIN public.master_v2_participants mp ON mp.session_id=s.id AND mp.user_id_snapshot=p_user
   AND mp.left_at IS NULL AND mp.engagement_state='attivo'
  JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=mp.character_id AND ch.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
  JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id=p_user AND pr.role IN('admin','master')
  WHERE s.id=p_session AND s.owner_kind='ai_service' AND s.master_user IS NULL
   AND s.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND l.is_active AND l.is_test AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.suspended_at IS NULL
   AND s.stato='in_corso')
  OR mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(p_session) IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 WITH released AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.id AS work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
    'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision) AS request,
   sw.context->>'source_revision' AS source_revision,
   jsonb_build_object('source_window_id',sw.id,'source_revision',sw.context->>'source_revision',
    'reason',sw.superseded_reason,'audit_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(a.details)) AS release
  FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id
   AND sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr ON dr.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id
   AND dr.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=w.id
   AND dr.request_key=w.request_key AND dr.status='failed' AND dr.dispatch_count=0
   AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND dr.charged_cost_usd=0 AND dr.upper_bound_cost_usd=0
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a ON a.receipt_id=dr.id
   AND a.event_code='staff_preprovider_request_retry'
   AND ((w.id='d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e'::uuid AND a.details->>'schema_version'='c1266-request-size-release/1') OR (w.id='f4f7185e-4aae-4edd-ac24-65f8dcfa36f5'::uuid AND a.details->>'schema_version'='c1266-turn-recovery-release/1'))
   AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND a.details->>'source_window_id'=sw.id::text
  WHERE p_session='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid
   AND w.master_session_id=p_session AND w.id IN('d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e'::uuid,'f4f7185e-4aae-4edd-ac24-65f8dcfa36f5'::uuid)
   AND w.state='failed' AND w.kind='director' AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND w.message_id IS NULL
   AND w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result)
   AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
   AND sw.context->>'source_revision'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
   AND sw.superseded_reason='staff_preprovider_request_retry'
   AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(sw.id)
 ),
 candidates AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.*,jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
   'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision) AS request
  FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w
  WHERE w.master_session_id=p_session AND (w.state='completed' OR (w.id='e366b9fa-54dc-4abd-8ba6-9ceee83be9a4'::uuid AND w.state='failed' AND w.kind='director'
   AND w.result_sha256='d0a4266f89198307e8c9020af67b4d2b099edc1cbf20e0aea5b38d1b78fc8ea9'
   AND public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result)='674c8253e511750022b6d9b477383aed5743ffb2c9ceee7b35a0125c10ac6201'
   AND w.receipt_id='07366817-3bf6-4bad-8387-0a4c0d1804f7'::uuid AND w.dispatch_receipt_id='e9524086-1e03-42d8-866b-1c12eb77840a'::uuid
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit aa JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ab ON ab.decision_work_id=w.id AND ab.master_session_id=p_session
    WHERE aa.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND aa.event_code='c1266_saved_director_applied'
     AND aa.details->>'schema_version'='c1266-saved-director-application/1' AND aa.details->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
     AND aa.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND aa.details->>'batch_id'=ab.id::text AND aa.details->>'writer_work_id'=ab.writer_work_id::text
     AND aa.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256 AND aa.details->>'generation_http_calls'='0' AND aa.details->>'failed_work_preserved'='true'
     AND ab.state='published' AND ab.published_at IS NOT NULL AND ab.message_id IS NOT NULL))) AND w.kind IN('director','narration')
   AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
   AND w.result_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
  ORDER BY w.created_at DESC,w.id LIMIT 128
 ), qualified AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.* FROM candidates w
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr ON dr.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id
   AND dr.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=w.id
   AND dr.request_key=w.request_key AND dr.status='success' AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND dr.event_kind='mission_generic_event' AND dr.renderer_version='mission-generic-runtime/1'
   AND dr.request_fingerprint=mission_internal.fingerprint(w.request)
   AND dr.envelope_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(dr.envelope) AND dr.authority_sha256=dr.envelope_sha256
   AND dr.envelope->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND dr.envelope->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
   AND dr.envelope->>'event_id'=w.event_id::text AND dr.envelope->>'authority_receipt_id'=w.authority_receipt_id::text
   AND dr.envelope->>'payload_sha256'=w.payload_sha256 AND dr.envelope->>'definition_sha256'=w.definition_sha256
   AND dr.envelope->'revision'=to_jsonb(w.revision)
  WHERE mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(w.id)->>'execution_context'='staff_mission'
   AND 1=(SELECT count(*) FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
    WHERE a.receipt_id=dr.id AND a.event_code='c1266_async_owner_v1'
     AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(a.details,ARRAY['schema_version','actor_user_id','work_id','request_sha256','envelope_sha256','provider_timeout_ms'])
     AND a.details->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-async-owner/1'
     AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND a.details->>'request_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.request)
     AND a.details->>'envelope_sha256'=dr.envelope_sha256 AND a.details->'provider_timeout_ms'='240000'::jsonb)
 ), published AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.id AS writer_work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,w.message_id
  FROM qualified w JOIN public.messages msg ON msg.id=w.message_id
   AND msg.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND msg.kind='fato' AND msg.recipient_user IS NULL AND msg.body=w.result->>'text'
  WHERE w.kind='narration' AND (
   EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.id=ub.source_window_id
     AND sw.master_session_id=p_session AND sw.consumed_message_id=w.message_id
    WHERE ub.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND ub.master_session_id=p_session AND ub.writer_work_id=w.id
     AND ub.state='published' AND ub.published_at IS NOT NULL AND ub.message_id=w.message_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs
    JOIN public.mission_run_publications pub ON pub.master_session_id=bs.master_session_id AND pub.event_id=bs.event_id
    JOIN public.mission_run_outbox ob ON ob.publication_id=pub.id AND ob.master_session_id=p_session AND ob.event_id=bs.event_id
     AND ob.state='published' AND ob.published_at IS NOT NULL
    WHERE bs.master_session_id=p_session AND bs.id=w.event_id AND bs.id=w.authority_receipt_id
     AND bs.id::text=w.payload->>'opening_start_receipt_id' AND bs.state='published' AND bs.published_at IS NOT NULL
     AND bs.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text AND bs.result->>'event_id'=bs.event_id::text
     AND bs.result->>'start_receipt_id'=bs.id::text
     AND pub.context_fingerprint=bs.result->>'context_fingerprint' AND ob.context_fingerprint=pub.context_fingerprint
     AND pub.status='committed'
     AND pub.body_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(msg.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')))
 ), settled_raw AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.request,w.id AS work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256) AS publication
  FROM qualified w JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=w.id WHERE w.kind='narration'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.request,w.id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256)
  FROM qualified w
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id
   AND sw.master_session_id=p_session AND sw.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL AND sw.superseded_at IS NULL
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub ON ub.source_window_id=sw.id AND ub.decision_work_id=w.id
   AND ub.master_session_id=p_session AND ub.state='published' AND ub.published_at IS NOT NULL
   AND ub.message_id=sw.consumed_message_id
  JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=ub.writer_work_id AND p.message_id=sw.consumed_message_id
  WHERE w.kind='director'
 ), settled AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM settled_raw s WHERE 1=(SELECT count(DISTINCT check_s.publication)
   FROM settled_raw check_s WHERE check_s.work_id=s.work_id AND check_s.request=s.request)
 ), items AS(
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',s.request),
   'request',s.request,'work_id',s.work_id,'receipt_id',s.receipt_id,'result_sha256',s.result_sha256,'publication',s.publication) AS item
  FROM settled s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','staff_tick','source_revision',t.source_revision),
   'request',s.request,'work_id',s.work_id,'receipt_id',s.receipt_id,'result_sha256',s.result_sha256,'publication',s.publication)
  FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr
   ON pr.master_session_id=p_session AND pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
